verdict_text: NO. The plan computes tv2 by subtracting `base` from `ft2` in step "subtract_: { from: base..., to: base...tv2 }", but by that point `base`'s MLP tensors have already been overwritten by the tv1 merge (`add_` in the prior task-vector-1 block). So tv2 = ft2 − (base + 0.4·(ft1−base)) instead of ft2 − base, exactly the ordering hazard the spec warns against in Objective/Why-it's-meaningful ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base"). Algebraically this yields out = 0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.4·ft2 instead of the required 0.2·base + 0.4·ft1 + 0.4·ft2, far exceeding the 1e-3 relative-error tolerance in Required result step 2 / Grading.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
